proposal.summary: A vulnerability in libcap's pthread_create() may allow a malicious actor to cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust process memory.
proposal.cwe_quote: This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.

AV.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap.

A.quote: which can exhaust the process memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the full report or advisory to determine affected libcap versions and reproduce the issue; if confirmed, develop and ship a patch that fixes pthread_create() error handling and add tests to prevent memory exhaustion. Notify downstream consumers and coordinate disclosure.

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap.
This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
